result.fundName: Axis Small Cap Fund - Direct Plan - Growth

insights: Axis Small Cap Fund - Direct Plan - Growth decisively outperforms its benchmark on rolling returns by 3.23% (21.41% vs 18.17%).
Chance of beating benchmark is 59.2% — moderate consistency, below the 70% Golden Triangle threshold.
Risk-adjusted returns are superior: Sharpe 1.34 vs benchmark 0.84, Sortino 1.63.
Defensive profile: beta 0.70 with 24% lower volatility than the benchmark.
Positive alpha of 10.84% suggests manager skill beyond market exposure (info ratio 0.41).
Higher drawdown risk: fund max drawdown -34.35% vs benchmark -59.78%.
Rolling return range spans -0.01% to 41.27% (41.28 pp spread) — consistency score 76.
Failed criteria: Chance of Beating Benchmark.
